serviceContent.title: Feature
serviceContent.description: Powerful capabilities that transform your field sales operation

salesFeature.subtitle: Instant Account Creation
salesFeature.title: Every Rep, One Assigned Customer
description: Assign specific customers to your field reps instantly.
No overlaps. No confusion.
The system tracks visits and orders automatically.

salesFeature.subtitle: Live Location Tracking
salesFeature.title: No Wrong Pings. Ever.
description: With a precise live location, billings happen only after check-in.
You know what actually happened — in real time, updated live.

salesFeature.subtitle: Credit Limit Control
salesFeature.title: Get Paid Before Risk Starts
description: Prevent bill creation if outstanding crosses the credit limit.
If due exists, the system prompts — collect first, then sell.
Management is freed from bad payments.

salesFeature.subtitle: Smart Pricing
salesFeature.title: No Wrong Pricing. Ever.
description: You don’t use one discount for all. The app auto-calculates schemes based on your party logic.
Party DG price
Discount tiers
Category-based pricing
The rep applies what the system already knows.

salesFeature.subtitle: Instant Approvals
salesFeature.title: No Calls. No Chasing. Just Approve.
description: Managers get order alerts instantly.
Approve or reject with one tap.
Fast approvals keep dispatch moving without delays.

salesFeature.subtitle: Auto-Invoicing
salesFeature.title: E-Invoices Flow Automatically
description: Approved orders convert to invoices and sync to Tally instantly.
No manual uploads. No tracking.
Zero mismatches. Zero backlog.

salesFeature.subtitle: Auto Payment Sync
salesFeature.title: No Gaps Between Sales and Payment
description: Collection details sync instantly across sales, finance, and accounting.
Every payment is tracked against the same invoice.

salesFeature.subtitle: One Unified View
salesFeature.title: Sales Data, Clear At One Screen
description: Overdue bills
Today's sales
Today's collections
Pending approvals
Branch-wise performance
Sales vs collection
Cash-back pending customers
Everything updates in real time.

salesFeature.subtitle: The Final Truth Remains True
salesFeature.title: Tally Always Updated. Always.
description: Approved orders, invoices, and collections move into Tally without retyping.
Master sync stays clean, reconciliation stays simple, and audits stay smooth.
